items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And, of course, Prince Robinson Robertson. He was a fantastic clarinet player and a good tenor player back in those days. He was with McKinney Cottonpickers.

ctx.x: Let's go on to some of the saxophone players. We've mentioned Hilton Jefferson. Of course we've got the Pres Dupreys, Coleman Hawkins.
And, of course, Prince Robinson Robertson.
